module.title: Core
module.description: Console access, node configuration and the audit log.

keys.demo-message: Text written into the demo managed file.
keys.demo-enabled: Whether the demo managed file has content.
keys.api-listen-port: TCP port the console/API listens on.
keys.directory-ldap-urls: Domain controllers to bind to, in order of preference (ldaps:// or ldap:// with StartTLS).
keys.directory-base-dn: Domain base DN. Empty means: read it from the rootDSE of the DC.
keys.directory-tls-server-name: Name to verify in the DC certificate. Empty means: the host from the URL.
keys.session-idle: Minutes of inactivity before a console session ends.
keys.session-absolute: Hours after login when a console session ends regardless of activity.
keys.session-require-totp: Users with a tier-0 role must set up an authenticator app (second factor).
keys.watcher-poll-seconds: How often the watcher asks its domain controller for directory changes (seconds).
